notesEn.TWN: In the UCDP/PRIO Armed Conflict Dataset, the only conflict located in Taiwan is “China - Taiwan” (conflict 232, interstate; the parties are written as Government of China and Government of Taiwan, i.e. the People's Republic of China and the Republic of China on Taiwan; incompatibility: government and territory, the territory given as Taiwan strait): war level (1,000 or more battle-related deaths in a year) in 1949, 1954 and 1958, and minor in 1950. The 1947 conflict “China: Taiwan” (conflict 217, starting 28 February 1947 in UCDP, i.e. the February 28 Incident; Government of China, i.e. the Republic of China government at the time, against Taiwanese insurgents; war level) is located in China in UCDP and is also counted here because the disputed territory is Taiwan. The Chinese Civil War of 1946–1949 (Government of China against the PLA) is located in China. UCDP records no conflict located in Taiwan after 1958.
notesEn.CHN: The 1947 conflict “China: Taiwan” (disputed territory: Taiwan) is also counted under Taiwan; “China - Taiwan” (1949–1958) is interstate and counted under both.
